architecture_guarantees: UsageKit uses Foundation plus narrowly scoped Darwin process primitives, has no app/UI/persistence dependencies, and supports provider-neutral dynamic reports with arbitrary window counts.
Codex reads use request-scoped app-server sessions; interactive login uses a separate login-scoped session.
Transport correlates multiple in-flight responses, fails observed terminal waiters before cleanup, and requires bounded cleanup of the direct child plus re-censused retained descendants.
Process ownership uses stable PID/start-time identity before signaling or accepting exit, and synthetic protocol fixtures record generated-schema provenance.
Linked Codex homes bind canonical path to device/inode and are revalidated at capture, process construction, and launch.
Legacy path-only Codex links remain loadable but cannot launch until explicitly relinked.
Missing, unsupported, or malformed optional token usage preserves required account and rate-limit results with typed degraded health.
Refresh persistence and presentation are fenced by provider identity, revision, input generation, invocation order, presentation context, deletion, and shutdown.
Production code does not access auth.json, and Codex remains disabled until P17.
